summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting an open-market share buyback transaction executed on 11 May 2026. It purchased 16,635,214 ordinary shares at a VWAP of 98.7780 pence per share, as part of a pre-announced buyback programme instructed on 29 January 2026. The shares will be cancelled. This is a routine capital return activity, not a special-situation event. There is no tender offer, no activist campaign, and no strategic review. The filing is a standard periodic report of a share repurchase programme. No further analysis is warranted.
